title: Applications from International Students for Local Schools
what_it_is: Applications from International Students for Local Schools

sections.label: International student Primary 1 applications
sections.summary: About 1,800 international student applications for Primary 1 in 2017 were rejected, as public schools prioritise Singaporeans and offer limited places to international students.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: For the 2016 Primary 1 Registration Exercise, around 1,800 applications from international students to enter Primary 1 in 2017 were rejected.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Our public school system is designed to cater to the needs of Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: While the Ministry of Education (MOE) values the diversity that international students bring to our schools, our priority is to serve the educational needs of Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Thus, we only offer a limited number of places to international students each year.
